questions.question: Which character must every Excel formula start with?
questions.explanation: Every formula begins with an equals sign, for example =A1+B1.

questions.question: What is the intersection of a row and a column called?
questions.explanation: A cell is a single box such as A1, formed where a row and column meet.

questions.question: How many columns does the range A1:C10 cover?
questions.explanation: A, B and C are three columns; the range spans rows 1 to 10.

questions.question: What does the error #DIV/0! mean?
options: Dividing by zero or an empty cell
questions.explanation: Dividing by zero or by an empty cell produces #DIV/0!.

questions.question: Which reference is absolute?
questions.explanation: $A$1 locks both the column and the row so it never changes when copied.

questions.question: Which keyboard shortcut opens the Format Cells dialog?
questions.explanation: Ctrl + 1 opens Format Cells for precise number, font and border control.

questions.question: By default, how are numbers aligned in a cell?
questions.explanation: Numbers align right and text aligns left, which helps spot mixed data.

questions.question: Which shortcut inserts an AutoSum formula?
questions.explanation: Alt + = inserts =SUM(...) for the cells above or to the left.

questions.question: What does the F4 key do while editing a cell reference?
questions.explanation: F4 cycles a reference through A1, $A$1, A$1 and $A1.

questions.question: Which action clears a cell's contents only?
questions.explanation: Delete clears contents; the Delete menu command removes the cell and shifts the rest.

questions.question: Which tool copies formatting without copying the value?
questions.explanation: Format Painter copies fonts, colours, borders and number formats only.

questions.question: What does the Wrap Text option do?
options: Wraps long text inside the cell
questions.explanation: Wrap Text keeps long labels visible by wrapping them onto multiple lines.

questions.question: Which item does Format Painter NOT copy?
questions.explanation: Format Painter only copies appearance, never the data itself.

questions.question: How is the value 50% stored by Excel?
questions.explanation: A percentage is stored as a decimal: 50% is really 0.5.

questions.question: Which of these prints by default?
questions.explanation: Borders are real formatting and always print; gridlines usually do not.

questions.question: Which feature hides rows that do not match criteria without deleting them?
questions.explanation: Filters temporarily hide non-matching rows; the data stays intact.

questions.question: Which shortcut creates an Excel Table?
questions.explanation: Ctrl + T turns a range into a table that auto-expands.

questions.question: Which chart type best shows a trend over time?
questions.explanation: A line chart shows how values change across a series such as months.

questions.question: What is conditional formatting used for?
options: Changing a cell's look based on its value
questions.explanation: Conditional formatting applies colours, bars or icons automatically based on values.

questions.question: When sorting a list, what should you always sort?
questions.explanation: Sort whole records so each row's values stay together; sorting one column scrambles data.

questions.question: Which function adds values together?
questions.explanation: SUM adds numbers, for example =SUM(A1:A10).

questions.question: Which function counts only numeric cells?
questions.explanation: COUNT counts numbers; COUNTA counts anything that is not empty.

questions.question: Which function returns one of two results based on a test?
questions.explanation: IF evaluates a logical test, for example =IF(A1>10,"High","Low").

questions.question: Which function adds only the values that meet a condition?
questions.explanation: SUMIF adds values matching one condition, for example =SUMIF(B2:B10,"North",C2:C10).

questions.question: Which function searches the first column of a range and returns a value from another column?
questions.explanation: VLOOKUP finds a value in the leftmost column and returns a value from the same row.

questions.question: Which function joins several pieces of text into one string?
questions.explanation: CONCAT (or the & operator) joins text together.

questions.question: What does AVERAGE ignore when calculating a mean?
questions.explanation: AVERAGE counts only numeric cells, ignoring text and blanks in a range.

questions.question: When does the AND function return TRUE?
options: When at least one condition is true
questions.explanation: AND requires every condition to be true; OR needs only one.
